title: GrowerHub news — new features and updates
heading: GrowerHub news
description: New app features, useful guides and fixes. See what changed and how to try it.

entries.text: The plant journal guide now covers the timeline, search, phone photos and starting without hardware.
The photo diary guide now explains image uploads, date edits and starting without hardware.
The microclimate history article now includes a small nursery example: one seedling zone, a daily chart, a follow-up inspection and connection limits.
Publication checks no longer report an error when new articles are added. Missing pages and translations are still detected.
The Home Assistant watering guide now explains MQTT connector compatibility, access scope and a first sensor check while existing HA automations stay in charge.
Clarified the English label for manual watering until leak detection.
Zigbee2MQTT connector v0.2.5 preserves library version information for device command compatibility checks. Updating is optional and does not enable irrigation.
The guide now links to the current connector ZIP and explains updating from v0.2.4 while keeping your personal configuration file.
The watering plan guide now explains available rain handling: outdoor precipitation, bounded delays and an explicit policy for unavailable forecasts.
Watering schedules now show English weekday abbreviations. Tuesday is no longer displayed as a power unit.
The watering plan refreshes after settings are saved. The previous plan is no longer shown as current while the new one loads.
Watering device cards direct you to a bounded session through the greenhouse. The off button remains available.
A new page opens at the top when you follow a menu or article link. Back navigation and section links retain their usual behaviour.
The watering log guide now explains measured, estimated and unknown water volumes.
